description:
Configure the self-hosted Jitsi Meet instance for high-fidelity music instruction. 

Goal: Edit the Jitsi Meet web configuration to enable stereo audio, disable peer-to-peer (P2P) mode, set the maximum Opus bitrate to 510kbps, and disable noisy microphone detection. 

1. Edit the configuration override file at `/home/ga/.jitsi-meet-cfg/web/custom-config.js`.
2. Add the following settings:
   - Enable stereo: `config.stereo = true;`
   - Disable P2P: `config.p2p = { enabled: false };` (or equivalent object merging)
   - Set max bitrate: `config.opusMaxAverageBitrate = 510000;`
   - Disable noisy mic detection: `config.enableNoisyMicDetection = false;`
3. Restart the Jitsi Meet web service (Docker Compose project is at `/home/ga/jitsi/`).
4. Verify the changes by checking `window.config` in the Firefox browser console at `http://localhost:8080`.
5. Take a screenshot of the browser console showing `config.stereo` is true and save it to `/home/ga/music_mode_verification.png`.
